text_block_list.text:
In the third "Representative Exchange 
Match," <chrname> claimed victory over Venus 
Park...!

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"So, how were they, Venus Park? Japan's 
Umamusume, that is."

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text: "...I'll pass that along to Master."

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text: "That there was love in Japan."

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you very much, Mei Satake. Thank 
you for such an eye-opening race."

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, are you finished already, Venus 
Park?"

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
"Did the digital Longchamp suit your 
tastes?"

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
"‘...It felt just like my beloved Paris. 
Right down to the flush of warmth after 
running.’"

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
"It is something that could never be 
realized without love. ...As is the peak 
condition of those Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
"...Master. Please retrain me even harder. 
Before those Umamusume arrive in Paris."

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
『The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe—I want to 
win it.』

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text: "...As you wish, princess."

Meanwhile, around that time, the 
excitement surrounding the race with Venus 
Park was sweeping across all of Japan.

text_block_list.name: Townsperson A
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> is way too strong...! She's definitely 
gonna win the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe 
too at this rate...!

text_block_list.name: Townsperson B
text_block_list.text:
"I can't wait...! Do I sign up as a 
Project L'Arc supporter on this website?!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Ms. Satake! Have the runners from 
'Project L'Arc' been decided yet?!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> is going to make the team, right?! I 
mean, she even took down that Venus Park, 
after all!!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Haha. It's only March. It is far too early 
to make a decision.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Still, I couldn't help but be captivated 
by <chrname>'s running. I'd like to agree with that 
opinion.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Now then, the selection for Japan's 
representative will be—at the end of June, 
just like last year.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
After the fourth "Representative Exchange 
Match," we will review everything, make a 
decision... and announce it.

Enthusiasm for "Project L'Arc" grew with 
each passing day. In response... <chrname> and I 
decided on something.
choice_data_list:
This passion is their expectation to see a 
dream. If so—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
So this is where you were! Trainer-san, is 
<chrname>-san heading straight to the next 
'Representative Exchange Match' like this?
choice_data_list:
Before that, I'll bring even more dreams 
to everyone.

text_block_list.text:
Our target is the final domestic spring GⅠ 
race available before going abroad. More 
than anything, it is tied deeply to 
"dreams"—
choice_data_list: I will be entering the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.text:
Even on that stage crowded with beloved 
star Umamusume, I want to become an 
Umamusume who can make you truly proud to 
call me "my dream."
choice_data_list:
And there, I'll show that she's the number 
one star!

text_block_list.text:
Let's show her strength to the people who 
support our shared promise. At the 
Takarazuka Kinen—we'll carry everyone's 
dreams!
